systems.owner: FamilySearch, under a protocole d'accord being formalised with the ministère de l'intérieur, de la décentralisation et du développement local (11 September 2024)

note: A protocol under negotiation for FamilySearch to digitise existing civil status registers and archives to preserve them: back-capture, class archive, so no fact; the terms of the contract were still being proposed on 11 September 2024.
